decisive_spans.text: More than five schistocytes/HPF, presence of anisocytosis and some spherocytes

response.rationale: The presence of more than five schistocytes/HPF, anisocytosis, and spherocytes strongly supports Thrombotic Microangiopathy (TMA). While DIC also presents with thrombocytopenia and anemia, the specific finding of schistocytes is a hallmark of TMA. Alcoholic Hemolytic Anemia is contradicted by the presence of schistocytes.
